name: three_way_match_checker
description: Use this tool to compare quantities and total amounts across Purchase Orders, Goods Receipt Notes, and Supplier Invoices. It detects overbilling, phantom deliveries, or mismatched totals. Always run this when analyzing a complete transaction.
schema: [{"id":0,"property":"quantity_ordered","type":"number","description":"Quantity ordered from the Purchase_Orders table","required":true},{"id":1,"property":"received_qty","type":"number","description":"Quantity received from the Goods_Receipt_Notes table","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"invoice_qty","type":"number","description":"Quantity billed on the Supplier_Invoices","required":true},{"id":3,"property":"total_amount","type":"number","description":"total_amount from the Purchase_Orders table","required":true},{"id":4,"property":"total_invoice_amount","type":"number","description":"Total amount from the Supplier_Invoices table","required":true}]
